Name: Magic Craft Dev
Author: randeri2211
Description: Development keys for Some Magic Craft Game: launch it, send debug commands to it and show its state.

Actions.Name: Game command
Actions.Tooltip: Sends a debug command to the running game (spawn, time, give, god...).

Actions.Name: Game readout
Actions.Tooltip: Shows a live value from the running game, optionally runs a command when pressed.

Actions.Name: Launch game
Actions.Tooltip: Starts the game with the 32 or 16 pixel art.

Actions.Name: Open art
Actions.Tooltip: Opens one of the game's art sheets in the image editor.
